verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents an MCP server for conversational domain search/availability, a CLI agent-skill that lets an AI agent run gddy commands in plain language (find domain, check pricing, register, update DNS), and natural-language domain search — covering core natural-language operation of the product. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server and agent-skill actually working as described, and broader coverage of natural-language control over non-domain features (Commerce, Auctions).
